id: \bReggie: Hello there. My name is Reggie. And you are?
en: \bReggie: Hello there. My name is Reggie. And you are?
it: \bReggie: Salve. Mi chiamo Reggie. E tu sei?

id: \b...So you're \PN. My brother Paul has mentioned you a few times. I take care of his Pokémon while he is traveling.
en: \b...So you're \PN. My brother Paul has mentioned you a few times. I take care of his Pokémon while he is traveling.
it: \b...Quindi sei \PN. Mio fratello Paul ti ha nominato un paio di volte. Mi prendo cura dei suoi Pokémon mentre è in viaggio.

id: \bI'm sure he has caused you some trouble so I would like to make it up to you.
en: \bI'm sure he has caused you some trouble so I would like to make it up to you.
it: \bSono sicuro che ti ha creato qualche problema, quindi vorrei farmi perdonare.

id: \bReggie: The move I'm going to teach you is called Brave Bird. It's a powerful Flying move that should help you beat Maylene.
en: \bReggie: The move I'm going to teach you is called Brave Bird. It's a powerful Flying move that should help you beat Maylene.
it: \bReggie: La mossa che ti insegnerò si chiama Baldeali. È una potente mossa di tipo Volante che dovrebbe aiutarti a battere Maylene.

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \bGlad I could help. Come back anytime.
en: \bGlad I could help. Come back anytime.
it: \bSono contento di esserti stato d'aiuto. Torna quando vuoi.

id: \rI don't like that we have a place to gamble. What will the children think?
en: \rI don't like that we have a place to gamble. What will the children think?
it: \rNon mi piace che abbiamo un posto dove si gioca d'azzardo. Cosa penseranno i bambini?

id: \rWould you like me to groom one of your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like me to groom one of your Pokémon?
it: \rVuoi che faccia la toelettatura a uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \rWhich Pokémon do you want me to groom?
en: \rWhich Pokémon do you want me to groom?
it: \rA quale Pokémon vuoi che faccia la toelettatura?

id: \rThere! \v[2] looks a lot happier and prettier now!
en: \rThere!  \v[2] looks a lot happier and prettier now!
it: \rEcco!  \v[2] ora sembra molto più felice e più bello!
